title: Final Architecture, Operations, and Benchmark Scorecard

retainedRuntimes.rationale: Deep ecosystem dependency on PyTorch, Transformers, SurrealDB client, and document processing pipelines. Rewriting into C/C++ or Rust would introduce immense maintenance risk without overcoming core model inference overhead.

retainedRuntimes.purpose: Native desktop shell, static asset serving, API reverse proxy, process supervision
retainedRuntimes.rationale: High memory efficiency, secure loopback binding (127.0.0.1), OS-owned process containment via job objects, and zero-dependency standalone binary distribution.
Provides high-performance multi-model document/graph storage with offline-first data persistence.

rejectedRewrites.candidate: Cython / PyO3 / C++ Native Leaf Extensions
rejectedRewrites.evidence: Profiling (L6) showed no pure Python CPU bottlenecks justifying memory-safety risks and FFI boundary maintenance overhead.

rejectedRewrites.candidate: Go or C# Auxiliary Helper Binaries
rejectedRewrites.evidence: Rust Tauri host already encapsulates process supervision, diagnostics, health checks, and verification cleanly. Auxiliary helpers would increase process count, memory RSS, installer size (+51.3 MB), and IPC complexity.

Study showed immense rewrite surface (5 route groups, complex async streaming) with high upstream sync drift risk and negligible performance win compared to proxying FastAPI through the native Rust Tauri host.

portConflictRecovery.behavior: Active probe on port 8502 and database ports during startup. If port is occupied, presents safe GUI dialog offering graceful termination of zombie process or aborting with fail-closed safety boundary.

rollbackMechanisms: Automated binary fallback to Electron v0.9.x
